name: Dokoka de Eros wa Gekidoshita. Shojo no Kuni no Alice
original_name: どこかでエロスは激怒した。処女の国のアリス
source:
Alice had the gift to see things normal people could not.
Her happy life was sometimes interrupted by violence.
One day the environment around her changed drastically... in sense only.
To the casual eye nothing was different... and yet everything was wrong.
What could this feeling be? Had it always been this way?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ081983.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
爱丽丝天生能够看见常人看不见的东西。
她幸福的生活，偶尔会被暴力打断。
某天，周围的一切发生了翻天覆地的变化……至少，她的感觉如此。
乍看之下，什么都没变……却又处处不对劲。
这种感觉究竟是什么？难道一直以来都是这样？

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ081983.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文页面[/url]]
